messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-12345 - Network>Edge Load Balancer: target_health degraded + TLS handshake error spike across eu-west-1 and ap-southeast-1. Alerts: 120 errors/min, p50 latency -> 800ms. Root TS=1809999999
pagerduty: PD-12345 acknowledged by alice (oncall) at 1809991000
alice (oncall): I'm on it, looking at LB target group health and edge TLS logs. tagging @carla and @ben. Any recent cert rotations?
carla (netops): no cert rotations deployed in last 24h. I'm seeing a small but correlated increase in SNI mismatch logs at the edge proxies: "SSL: unknown_name". Also Route53 change history shows two low-ttl updates about 30m ago for service-weighting.
ben (sre): pulling metrics now. backend-targets unhealthy count jumped at 1809990800. NLB connection resets and 502s from edge to backend pool. Could be DNS propagation + old nodes still referenced.
dave (support): multiple customer tickets reporting 502s and timeouts to /api/generate. Impact: 5% global traffic, mostly EU and APAC customers. Notifying top-tier customers.
eva (pm): keeping exec update on standby. what's ETA for mitigation?
alice (oncall): quick mitigation plan: 1) temporarily divert traffic away from eu-west-1 ap-southeast-1 by adjusting weighted routing -> direct to us-east-1 pool 2) lower edge TLS strictness to accept legacy SNI while we debug 3) roll LB targets through health check bounce 4) follow up with DNS TTL re-eval.
ben (sre): agree. I'll start weight shift in Route53. lowering EU/AP weights to 0.1 and increasing US to 0.8; keep small % for canary. Executing now.
carla (netops): reconfiguring edge proxies to accept alternate SNI fallback (non-production) for the next 20m. command: ```kubectl -n edge set env deploy/edge-proxy SNI_FALLBACK=true``` doing rolling restart of edge-proxy pods in eu-west-1 first.
fred (infra): on the LB side I'm cycling unhealthy targets in eu-west-1 target group: draining then re-registering healthy instances. health-check timeout set to 10s, I'll tighten to 5s after drain. Running automated script: ```./scripts/rotate-targets --region eu-west-1 --group api-backend```
alice (oncall): pd update: ack -> incident in progress. tagging incident channel for ops standup. Everyone paste short status updates here so we have single source of truth. :thumbsup: 
dave (support): posted customer comms draft to #support-private, sending to top-5 impacted customers now.
ben (sre): Route53 change submitted (change-id C123ABC): weights applied at 1810000200. watching propagation. Current error-rate dropping to 40/min. p50 -> 450ms.
carla (netops): edge proxy restart eu-west-1 done. SNI mismatch logs decreased ~70% on that region. ap-southeast-1 still noisy, performing same restart.
alice (oncall): ben, once we confirm apac improves, can you start controlled rollback of weights to normal but keep canary? aim to avoid oscillation.
ben (sre): agreed. waiting for apac to stabilize. If error rate < 10/min for 10m we start incremental restore (10% steps).
eva (pm): ETA? customers asking for timeline in 15m.
fred (infra): target rotate script finished for eu-west-1. Health checks passing now. 5 healthy / 0 unhealthy.
dave (support): apac customer reports partial recovery (timeouts reduced but some 502s).
ben (sre): apac proxy restart completed, metrics: errors -> 22/min, p50 260ms. Starting weight restore: +10% to apac, -10% us-east. change-id C123ABD applied at 1810001900.
alice (oncall): good. keep gradual. Also adding a temporary runbook note: if SNI noise returns, revert SNI_FALLBACK env and escalate to cert-ops.
carla (netops): note: SNI_FALLBACK has slight risk for misrouting for some private deployments. I'm monitoring.
ben (sre): 15m after first weight change: overall errors 12/min, impact <1% traffic. Routing stable.
dave (support): updating customers: majority restored, some still in-flight. No data loss, only request errors/timeouts.
eva (pm): preparing postmortem template. Need customer impact summary and timeline.
alice (oncall): I'm going to shift this to "monitoring" in 30m if no regression. handoff to ben for on-call follow-up. @ben you're the responder for post-incident actions.
ben (sre): taking follow-up. I'll open a ticket for route53 TTL review and edge proxy SNI handling.
incident-bot: Incident PD-12345 status updated: mitigated -> monitoring. Priority lowered.
pagerduty: PD-12345 resolved by alice (oncall) at 1810003500
alice (oncall): thanks team. short notes: root suspected: partial DNS weight propagation combined with an older edge proxy SNI config. Mitigation: weight shift, proxy SNI fallback, target rotation. Follow-ups: permanent SNI fallback vetting, Route53 change process to avoid low-ttl churn, improved health-check alert thresholds. I'll kick off the postmortem doc and link it here when ready. :white_check_mark:
